item.tib: lta ba sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'dus kyi bon gser gyi yang zhun las rgyal chos gser gyi thur ma
item.coloph: sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po'i (pos) tshe spungs gsang ba'i gter nas gdan drangs te/shog ser sor bzhi/ dkyus gsum/ khru do yod pa gcig la/ brag dben pa'i gnas bkra shis lding du shog ser la phab pa/ yi ge pa ni ming can ya ngal g.yung drung rgyal pos brgyud pa lags so//
